profile.headline: Proprietor at Morris Engineering
profile.jobTitle: Electrical Engineer / Software Engineer / Systems Integration & Test Engr
profile.summary: Experienced Software and Systems Integration Engineer with a Six Sigma Green Belt, international experience, and a broad range of technical expertise.  I am a detail driven senior/staff engineer with expertise in software, hardware, and firmware at the design level with development and testing experience in a wide variety of industries, platforms, and environments.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer / Software Engineer / Systems Integration & Test Engr
positions.description:
As an Engineer at Morris Engineering, a services company, I have provided a broad range of solutions to a wide variety of high technology companies as an independent contractor in electrical engineering. A variety of short and long term contracts have been worked for a variety of well-known companies, including: 
○	ACSS / L3 Communications (Glendale, AZ) 
○	Hamilton Sundstrand (San Diego, CA) 
○	Honeywell (Deer Valley, AZ; Glendale, AZ; Olathe, KS; Tucson, AZ) 
○	Northrop Grumman, Norden Systems (Norwalk, CT) 
○	Sargent Aerospace & Defense (Tucson, AZ) 
○	Sensor Technologies & Systems (Scottsdale, AZ) 
Services have been supplied for embedded microprocessor applications and digital signal processor (DSP) designs, programming, and testing. Contributed and managed full development life cycle delivery services for hardware, software, systems integration, and testing. Well versed in real-time operating systems, environments, platforms, processes, and tools including DO-178B, AS9100, DOORS, ClearCase, ClearQuest, and ReqSuite.
